name: A2E Suite — dependency-ready extraction batch 10 (2026-09-22, HEAD 59a5ce7b): the INSTALL_APP idempotency defect found during the orchestrator's 2026-09-22 Tier-2 live pass
description: Re-scan of PLAN.md and phase reports after the orchestrator's 2026-09-22 Tier-2 live pass (commit 59a5ce7b, verifying US-074/US-075). US-074 and US-075 are both complete. The orchestrator found one new code defect during the verification pass (phase-01-report 20:15 CEST entry): `applyWorkspaceTemplateOperation`'s INSTALL_APP step calls `installApplication` unconditionally even when the app is already INSTALLED at the same version — `validateVersionProgression` throws APP_ALREADY_INSTALLED/SAME_VERSION and the step reports FAILED with `appliedTemplateKeyVersion: null`. This blocks M2 exit criteria (c)/(d) honestly and prevents retry completion. Fix: skip/mark-succeeded when the app is already installed at a compatible version. All other open bullets remain Tier 2 (needs running app/browser/multi-session), blocked upstream, or decision-gated — exactly as deferred-batch9.md records. Batch numbering continues at US-076.

userStories.title: Fix INSTALL_APP step idempotency — installApplication called unconditionally even when app is already installed at same version, causing APP_ALREADY_INSTALLED/FAILED and blocking M2 retry completion
userStories.description: As a workspace owner retrying a preset apply after a partial failure, I want the INSTALL_APP step to succeed without error when the target app is already installed at a compatible version, so that retry completion is honest and M2 exit criteria (c)/(d) can be satisfied.
acceptanceCriteria: PLAN anchor (phase-01-report 2026-09-22 20:15 CEST, verbatim): 'NEW DEFECT found (recorded, not fixed — executor queue): applyWorkspaceTemplateOperation's INSTALL_APP step calls installApplication unconditionally, even when the app is already INSTALLED at the same version — validateVersionProgression then throws SAME_VERSION/APP_ALREADY_INSTALLED and the step reports FAILED with appliedTemplateKeyVersion: null. Reproduced: STUDENT apply on Apple with A2E Documents 0.2.0 already installed → INSTALL_APP FAILED (preview had correctly shown currentlyInstalled: true). Fix direction: skip/mark-succeeded when the app is already installed at a compatible version (the preview's currentlyInstalled already computes this), or make installApplication idempotent for SAME_VERSION. This blocks M2 exit criteria (c)/(d) honestly — a retry after partial success can never complete while any required app is already installed.'

installTemplateApplication in workspace-template.service.ts checks applicationService.findByUniversalIdentifier before calling installApplication; if already installed at a compatible version, returns succeeded without calling installApplication
Regression test: app already installed → INSTALL_APP step status 'succeeded', installApplication NOT called, appliedTemplateKeyVersion set correctly
Regression test: retry of a failed INSTALL_APP step when app was installed between retries → step status 'succeeded', installApplication NOT called
Existing tests unchanged: app not installed → installApplication IS called (default findByUniversalIdentifier returns null)
userStories.notes: PRIORITY 0, defect #3 — extracted from phase-01-report 20:15 CEST 2026-09-22 'executor queue' note. dependsOn: nothing (independent of US-074/US-075). The preview already computes currentlyInstalled correctly — the apply step just needs to mirror it.
userStories.completionNotes: Fixed installTemplateApplication in packages/twenty-server/src/engine/core-modules/onboarding/workspace-template.service.ts: after versionCompatibility check, call applicationService.findByUniversalIdentifier; if the application is already installed, log and return succeeded without calling installApplication. Added 2 regression tests in workspace-template.service.spec.ts covering the live-reproduced scenario (already-installed idempotent apply) and the retry-after-install scenario.
